With known support, squeezing gap, a lower bound on nonzero couplings and calibrated iid heterodyne data, it learns the accepted pure state from unconditioned preparations without an additional inverse-herald-probability factor. Physical production still pays the herald yield. General phases, mixed states, unknown loss during heralding, hidden contamination, practical matching-FPRAS performance and historical priority are outside the established scope.
